image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a metallic automotive disk brake rotor. The image focuses on the central hub area and the inner portion of the friction surface. Visible features include three lug bolt holes arranged in a triangular pattern, a large central mounting aperture with a keyway notch, and the machined metal surface of the rotor face showing concentric machining marks and light reflections. The outer edge of the rotor and the caliper assembly are cropped out of the frame.
